title: Preserve metrics timestamp offsets
summary: Keep aware completed-job timestamps in their recorded offset while selecting the latest completion by absolute time.
reason: GitHub Actions runs in UTC, so converting aware timestamps to the host timezone changed the metrics API payload and made it disagree with recorded completion evidence.
behavior_before: Metrics converted each aware completion timestamp and its date bucket to the host timezone, making the API response differ between local development and CI.
behavior_after: Metrics retain each recorded aware timestamp and source-local date while calculating the latest completion from timezone-aware chronological values.
manual_validation: GREEN: the focused mixed-offset regression and the full test_metrics_feature module (10 tests) passed after preserving recorded offsets and sorting by aware timestamps.
RED: the focused mixed-offset timestamp regression failed because the +05:30 completion was converted to the host -04:00 offset.
rollback_plan: Revert the metrics timestamp/date normalization changes and rerun the focused mixed-offset regression if consumers formally require host-local presentation instead of preserved completion evidence.
notes:
Preserve aware completion timestamps and date buckets without converting to the host timezone.
Add a regression for mixed aware timestamp offsets and chronological latest completion selection.
Refresh generated summary after making metrics timestamps offset-stable.
Refresh generated summary after adding the mixed-offset regression.
Record generated summary for the metrics timestamp change packet.
